headline: Appointed Steffani J. Santiago to fill a vacant seat for a term ending January 2030, confirmed 17-0.
summary: The convention first adopted its rules by unanimous consent. Six candidates then made three-minute presentations, in an order set by lottery, and Santiago was sworn in after the roll call.
decisions: Approved the Rules and Regulations of the Convention by unanimous consent, 17-0.
Approved the appointment of Steffani J. Santiago to fill the vacant School Committee seat, 17-0.

decision_titles: Rules and Regulations of the Convention
Appointment of Steffani J. Santiago to School Committee
plain_text:
JOINT CONVENTION 
OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND THE SCHOOL COMMITTEE 
 
The Joint Convention of the City Council and School Committee of the city of Fitchburg was held 
at the Legislative Building at 700 Main Street, on September 14, 2026.   
 
The meeting was called to order by Mayor Squailia at 5:15 P.M.  The meeting opened with a 
salute to the Flag led by Councilor Beauchemin. The City Clerk called the roll of the Joint 
Convention members seventeen (17) members were present.  
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
Mayor Squailia read the Warrant for the Joint Convention of The City Council and the School 
Committee: 
 
WARRANT FOR A JOINT CONVENTION 
OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND THE SCHOOL COMMITTEE 
 
July 9, 2026  
 
The City Council and the School Committee will meet in Joint Convention 
Monday, September 14, 2026 at 5:15PM 
Legislative Building 
700 Main Street, Fitchburg, MA 01420 
 
The following matters are on the agenda for the continuation of the Joint Convention held on 
Monday, September 14, 2026: 
 
To appoint one (1) member to the Fitchburg School Committee to fill the vacancy created by the 
resignation of a member whose term expires in January 2030. Pursuant to the Fitchburg City 
Charter, the appointee shall serve until the next regular municipal election, at which time the 
vacancy shall be filled for the remainder of the unexpired term ending January 2030. 
 
The following will be the order of business: 
1. Call to Order 
2. Pledge of Allegiance 
3. Roll Call attendance 
4. Read Warrant for Joint Convention 
5. Vote to accept Rules of the Convention 
6. City Clerk reads names of candidates for the Fitchburg School Committee seat 
7. Assistant City Clerk conducts lottery for order of presentations by candidates  
8. Presentations by candidates (3 minutes each) 
9. Assistant City Clerk Tallies Ballot for the seat 
10. Assistant City Clerk announces member elected 
11. Swearing in of new member 
12. Adjourn  
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Vote on the Rules of the Convention 
Mayor Squailia requested a motion to approve the Rules and Regulations.   
 
Motion and second to approve the Rules and Regulations by unanimous consent, 17/0.  
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------   
Candidates 
The City Clerk read the names of the candidates for the Fitchburg School Committee seat in 
alphabetical order: 
1. Annie Louise Belmer 
2. Nathan D. Bilotta   
3. Erynn E. Dayhoff   
4. Jean Raabe    
5. Steffani J. Santiago   
6. Deanna “DJ” Tardiff  
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
Order of Presentation 
The City Clerk conducted a lottery to determine the order of presentation for the candidates: 
 
1. Erynn E. Dayhoff 
2. Nathan D. Bilotta 
3. Jean Raabe 
4. Steffani J. Santiago 
5. Annie Louise Belmer 
6. Deanna Tardiff 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
The City Clerk and the Assistant City Clerk distributed ballots for the appointment. 
 
The City Clerk and the Assistant City Clerk tallied the ballots. 
 
The City Clerk announced that Steffani J. Santiago received the Fitchburg School Committee 
appointment.  
 
The City Clerk conducted a roll call vote to confirm the appointment of Steffani J. Santiago. The 
motion passed with seventeen (17) votes in favor and zero (0) opposed 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
Swearing-In 
The City Clerk administered the oath of office to Steffani J. Santiago as a member of the 
Fitchburg School Committee. 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
 
 
The meeting adjourned at 5:52 P.M.   
 
Very truly yours, 
 
 
Joanna Bilotta 
City Clerk
